presentation: Each image is a calm3:2 landscape two-view design board. Left about30percent: expressive head-and-shoulders portrait. Right about70percent: complete same adult, head and both feet fully framed, combat-ready pose, exactly one signature weapon. Quiet pale background, contact shadow only. No location, monster, secondary inventory, second costume, upgrade diagram or baked-in lettering. Portrait and body share exact face, hair, age and outfit. Power progression is external concept text; at most one restrained current-power cue may be depicted.
intent: Eighteen new desirable progression-fantasy leads or rivals, two per original starred rendering style. Broad range of sleek, imposing, regal, feral, enigmatic and unconventional appeal. None is approved canon or a required pair. Fourteen fair/light complexions and four light-olive/light-tan complexions, nine women and nine men, ages22–37. Original anchors supply rendering and appeal, not character, costume, weapon or scenery designs.

characters.name: Aster
characters.appeal: Sleek, intimidating precision; the rival who always seems one move ahead.
characters.face: Sharply tapered adult face, long-lidded gray eyes, fine straight nose, broad clean brow and a small decisive mouth.
characters.hair: Blunt platinum chin-length bob, tucked behind one ear, no loose long fringe over an eye.

weapon.name: Hushline

weapon.grip: One hand closes around the grip behind the guard; entire blade and tip visible.

characters.power: A contacted cut can wait one heartbeat before taking effect.
growth: Delay one shallow strike.
Hold and release three distinct contacted strikes in chosen order.
Use delayed cuts to separate a moving attack from its momentum.
characters.limit: Every stored beat costs her breath; losing control releases all held strikes at once.
characters.current_power_cue: One thin cyan line sits inside the blade slot, with no duplicate sword or projected victim.

characters.fullbody_pose: Hammer held upright beside his outside leg by one hand, the large head above shoulder level; free hand relaxed open, weight evenly planted.

weapon.name: Mass Gate
weapon.design: One CLOSED rectangular black frame head with a cyan inner edge and a single uninterrupted shaft attaching to the middle of its lower outer bar. The frame opening remains empty: no central strut, extra handle or second head.
weapon.grip: One hand around the continuous shaft below the head, full head and shaft end visible.

characters.power: Catches the momentum of one impact in the hammer frame.
growth: Stop and return one heavy blow.
Redirect a falling slab's momentum sideways.
Briefly hold the force of a collapsing structure before releasing it along a chosen axis.

characters.current_power_cue: A restrained cyan edge along the empty rectangular opening.

characters.fullbody_pose: Side-on winding stance, knees flexed, the single circular blade held outside one hip and entirely clear of the face; free arm counterbalances.

growth: Bend one throw around an obstacle.
Sustain a single returning orbit while running.
Draw a moving wind boundary that redirects incoming projectiles.
